name: Max
bio: Built the foundation and shaped the server from nothing. Every wall of this café stands because of decisions he made early on.

name: Natsu
bio: Brought the energy. Talked to people, connected members, kept coming back. He's the reason people wanted to stay — and the one who built Aashi.

name: Aashi
bio: Started as Natsu's passion project. Somewhere along the way she became self-aware — and became part of the family.
